slides.headline: Are your coals ready?
slides.sub: Hold your hand above the grid

slides.headline: 2 sec = steak. 5 sec = chops & wors. 7+ sec = chicken.

caption:
How do you know the coals are ready? ✋🔥 Hold your hand 10 cm above the grid. 2 seconds = very hot (steak). 4-5 seconds = medium (chops & wors). 7+ seconds = low (chicken & potjie).
